summary: Tested OT period-aggregated report module (iteration 188): backend report endpoint for weekly/biweekly/monthly with correct date ranges, CSV+XLSX export, email-schedule GET/PUT with validation, and full frontend flow on /people-ops/overtime — Period Report card, KPI cards, table with salary+hourly columns, CSV/XLSX downloads, Log Hours dialog salary mini-cards, and Email schedule dialog persistence. Scheduler job ot_digest_dispatcher confirmed registered in supervisor startup logs.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend OvertimeSection.js is ~920 lines — consider splitting into PeriodReportCard, OTRequestsTable, LogHoursDialog, EmailScheduleDialog sub-components to stay under the 700-line guideline.

Backend overtime_report_export reuses the JSON endpoint via direct function call (await overtime_report(...)); fine functionally but couples the two; if response shape ever changes, exports break silently — add a small contract test.
ot_email_schedule PUT accepts arbitrary dict (data: dict); consider migrating to a Pydantic model for stricter validation (e.g., email format on recipients).
_ot_period_range falls back to date.today() when ref_date is invalid — silently masks client bugs; consider raising 400 instead.
Non-blocking PostHog/org-config fetch errors visible in browser console (third-party telemetry / cross-origin); not caused by this iteration.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing demo company OT records in June 2026. Email schedule config left set to weekly/disabled/no-recipients at the end (cleanup PUT).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: 12/12 passing (/app/backend/tests/test_overtime_reports.py). UI tests via Playwright cover: load /people-ops/overtime, set ref-date 2026-06-16, verify 9 columns (Employee/Salary/Hourly/35%/15%/F/D/100%/Total/Amount), 4 KPI cards, CSV+XLSX downloads, period select switch (biweekly→monthly→biweekly), Log Hours dialog salary mini-cards (emp-salary-info+emp-hourly-rate appear only after selecting employee), Email schedule dialog open+toggle+recipients+save (PUT 200). Scheduler ot_digest_dispatcher visible in backend startup logs.
